title: Director, Digital Twin & Intelligent Manufacturing Capabilities
text:
**Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-263851 **Date posted** 08/11/2026

 

Position Summary

The Director, Digital Twin & Intelligent Manufacturing Capabilities is responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise strategy, technology direction, governance, standards, and capability roadmap for Digital Twins, Process Twins, Process Intelligence, Modeling, Simulation, Automation-enabled Manufacturing, and AI-driven manufacturing capabilities across Global Technical Operations (GTO). This role serves as GTO's enterprise leader for Digital Twin and Process Intelligence capabilities and is accountable for shaping how manufacturing science, process knowledge, automation, data, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies are leveraged to improve technology transfer, process understanding, manufacturing readiness, operational performance, and business outcomes across the product lifecycle.

The Director will partner closely with MPAS, Tech Transfer, BPD, Singapore manufacturing and digital organizations, Alexion, FMC, Regional Digital Leads, Manufacturing, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI, Automation, and Site Digital teams to establish enterprise-scale capabilities and implementation frameworks that can be deployed consistently across the manufacturing network. While Regional Digital Leads and site organizations retain accountability for site-level deployment and adoption, this role is responsible for defining the enterprise capability strategy, technology direction, operating model, governance, standards, and reusable assets required to scale Digital Twin and Process Intelligence capabilities across GTO.

This position requires deep expertise in Digital Twin and Intelligent Manufacturing capabilities, combined with strong technology leadership, manufacturing and process-science credibility, automation awareness, systems thinking, vendor evaluation experience, AI and advanced analytics fluency, and a proven ability to lead large-scale cross-functional transformation initiatives in complex global organizations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Strategy & Capability Leadership**

* Define and maintain the enterprise strategy for Digital Twins, Process Twins, Process Intelligence, Modeling, Simulation, and Intelligent Manufacturing capabilities across GTO.

* Establish and evolve a multi-year capability roadmap aligned with GTO priorities, Digital Tech Transfer strategy, manufacturing modernization initiatives, and enterprise digital objectives.

* Identify strategic opportunities to improve technology transfer, process characterization, scale-up, manufacturing readiness, process robustness, operational performance, and business value.

* Develop capability maturity models, adoption frameworks, and value realization approaches to support enterprise scaling.

* Translate business needs and manufacturing challenges into actionable capability roadmaps, standards, investment priorities, and implementation approaches.

**Technology, Automation & Intelligent Manufacturing Leadership**

* Define how Digital Twins, manufacturing systems, automation environments, process data, simulation platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities work together as part of GTO’s Intelligent Manufacturing ecosystem.

* Lead evaluation and selection of Digital Twin, Process Intelligence, Modeling, Simulation, and AI-enabled manufacturing technologies.

* Drive technology strategy and investment recommendations across platforms, tools, vendors, and strategic partnerships.

* Assess emerging technologies and industry developments to guide future capability investments and roadmap decisions.

* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, IT, Data & AI, Automation, and Digital organizations to define scalable architectures, integration approaches, and operational models.

* Establish approaches for connecting process knowledge, manufacturing systems, automation platforms, process data, simulations, and Digital Twins through effective data flows and information architectures.

* Guide build-versus-buy decisions and strategic technology direction for Digital Twin and Intelligent Manufacturing capabilities.

**Process Intelligence, Modeling & Digital Twin Governance**

* Establish governance frameworks, standards, methodologies, and best practices for Digital Twin and Process Intelligence capabilities across GTO.

* Define and oversee model lifecycle management approaches, including model transition, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, documentation, and retirement.

* Establish ownership models, stewardship expectations, support models, and decision-making frameworks for Digital Twin and Process Intelligence capabilities.

* Develop reusable methods, templates, and standards that enable scalability and consistency across products, sites, and manufacturing networks.

* Ensure Digital Twin and Process Intelligence initiatives are aligned to enterprise quality, regulatory, and operational expectations.

**Community of Practice & Capability Development**

* Establish and lead the GTO Digital Twin & Process Intelligence Community of Practice and Center of Excellence.

* Build and maintain a network of practitioners and subject matter experts across Manufacturing, MPAS, Tech Transfer, BPD, Automation, IT, Data & AI, Site Digital organizations, and Regional Digital Leads.

* Develop standards, reference architectures, implementation guidance, training materials, and best practices to support capability maturity and enterprise adoption.

* Promote innovation, knowledge sharing, and capability development across the organization.

* Sponsor and oversee Digital Twin and Process Intelligence initiatives involving interns, graduate students, and university partnerships aligned to strategic business priorities.

* Collaborate with academic institutions, innovation partners, and external research organizations to advance Digital Twin and Intelligent Manufacturing capabilities.

**Enterprise Transformation & Business Partnership**

* Partner closely with MPAS, Tech Transfer, BPD, Singapore manufacturing organizations, Alexion, FMC, and Manufacturing organizations to identify opportunities and shape future-state capabilities.

* Ensure Digital Twin and Process Intelligence strategies align with broader Digital Tech Transfer, Intelligent Manufacturing, and GTO transformation objectives.

* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across business, scientific, manufacturing, digital, and technology organizations.

* Influence strategic decisions and drive organizational alignment without direct authority.

* Translate emerging technologies into scalable business capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**External Innovation & Vendor Management**

* Build and manage relationships with strategic technology vendors, industry organizations, academic partners, and innovation ecosystems.

* Lead technology assessments, proof-of-concept initiatives, capability evaluations, and vendor-selection activities.

* Monitor industry developments in Digital Twins, Process Intelligence, Manufacturing Analytics, Simulation, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Intelligent Manufacturing.

* Guide strategic partnerships and investment decisions that strengthen GTO’s long-term Digital Twin and Process Intelligence capabilities.

**Qualifications**

Required

* Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.

* 12-20+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, manufacturing, engineering, automation, process development, digital transformation, or related industries.

* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale Digital Twin, Process Twin, Process Intelligence, Simulation, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Intelligent Manufacturing initiatives.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing systems, automation environments, industrial data flows, manufacturing data ecosystems, and Intelligent Manufacturing concepts.

* Experience evaluating technology platforms, software vendors, emerging technologies, and digital capabilities.

* Demonstrated ability to develop capability roadmaps, guide technology investments, and establish enterprise governance and standards.

* Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, simulation technologies, and their practical application in manufacturing and process environments.

* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives in highly matrixed organizations.

* Proven ability to influence senior scientific, manufacturing, business, and technology stakeholders without direct authority.

* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in biologics manufacturing, process development, manufacturing sciences, technology transfer, or technical operations.

* Experience working across BPD, MPAS, Manufacturing, Tech Transfer, Automation, IT, Data & AI, and Enterprise Architecture organizations.

* Familiarity with Digital Twin and Process Intelligence platforms such as BaseTwo, M-Star, FlexSim, BioSolve, Solvace, AspenTech, AVEVA, or similar ecosystems.

* Experience establishing enterprise communities of practice, governance models, capability-development programs, or Centers of Excellence.

* Experience leading innovation partnerships, university collaborations, internship programs, or applied research initiatives.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

The annual base pay for this position ranges from *The annual base pay (or hourly rate of compensation) for this position ranges from* $161,252.80 - $241,879.20 *. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.*

**Are you ready to bring new insights and fresh thinking to the table?**

Fantastic! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

Apply today.
